TextView.android:text: Lesson 2 - Unit 5: Past, Present, and Future Verbs
To turn a root word into a present tense verb, insert -um- and repeat the first syllable.
Placed between first consonant and vowel.
Placed at the beginning of the word
To turn a root word into a future tense verb, repeat the first syllable.
You may also do this with 'Mag-' to turn verbs into a definite future action by repeating the first syllable.
He is running in the house.
Si Marites ay lumalangoy sa pool.
Marites is swimming in the pool.
We will walk to school tomorrow.
Uminom ng Coca-cola sina Lolo at Lola.
Umakyat si Ate Cherry sa bundok.
